# @stackline/angular-data-table-component 22.1.0

@stackline/angular-data-table-component is an Angular 22 NgModule library for data-heavy application screens. It includes a styled table component and a view-independent controller for custom Angular markup.

## Installation

```bash
npm install @stackline/angular-data-table-component
```

Import DataTableModule from @stackline/angular-data-table-component and add it to an Angular NgModule imports array. Render the stackline-data-table selector with columns and data inputs.

## Angular Compatibility

The 22.x package line accepts @angular/common and @angular/core versions >=22.0.0 <23.0.0. The release is built with Angular 22.1.3 and TypeScript 6.0.3. Historical package majors 2 and 4 through 21 remain on npm for matching Angular majors.

## Runtime Exports

- DataTableModule: NgModule exporting DataTableComponent.
- DataTableComponent: styled Angular table component.
- HeadlessDataTableController: table behavior for custom Angular markup.
- createDataTableController(options): creates a headless controller.

## Type Exports

- DataTableColumn
- DataTableColumnFilter
- DataTableColumnPinningState
- DataTableRowPinningState
- DataTableStateChangeEvent
- DataTableSelectionState
- DataTableSortEvent
- DataTablePageEvent
- DataTableRowsPerPageEvent
- DataTableExpandEvent
- DataTableCellContext
- DataTableExpandableContext
- ConditionalStyle
- HeadlessDataTableOptions

## Capabilities

The component supports client and controlled sorting, filtering, and pagination; multi-row and single-row selection; global and column filters; column visibility, ordering, sizing, grouping, and sticky pinning; row grouping and pinning; expandable rows; virtual row windows; custom Angular templates; conditional styles; keyboard activation; ARIA state; and default or dark themes.

## Important Inputs

- columns, data, keyField
- pagination, paginationServer, paginationPerPage, paginationTotalRows
- sortServer, manualSorting, manualFiltering, manualPagination
- globalFilter, columnFilters
- selectableRows, selectableRowsSingle, selectableRowsVisibleOnly
- expandableRows, expandableRowTemplate
- columnVisibility, columnOrder, columnPinning, columnSizing
- groupBy, grouping, rowPinning
- virtualRows, virtualStartIndex, virtualRowCount
- theme, dense, striped, responsive

## Important Outputs

- sortChange
- selectedRowsChange
- pageChange
- rowsPerPageChange
- rowClicked
- rowDoubleClicked
- rowExpandToggled
- globalFilterChange
- columnFiltersChange
- columnVisibilityChange
- columnOrderChange
- groupingChange
- tableStateChange

## Examples

The Angular 22 documentation contains 40 runnable examples. Source panels are loaded from the real component HTML and TypeScript files published beside the application.
